summary: Tested flight itinerary (segments + fare breakdown), PATCH rollups, legacy segment derivation, calendar per-segment items + competition-day fold with passengers, inbox dup-check / merge (single + confirm-all), and the UI: Flight itinerary editor (create + edit), competition flight card, Money tab travel subtotal / grand total / all filters, and inbox flight-draft confirm. Backend 7/9 pytest pass (2 real bugs). Frontend: editor, card, Money tab totals & filters all correct and match API numbers; inbox 'already has a flight' Alert hangs on web (RN-web Alert is a no-op), merge path verified via API instead.

critical.issue: Merging an import into a direction that already has a detailed fare leaves stale breakdown values. Existing outbound {pax 2, base 200, tax 30, bags 70, seats 40} + imported flat cost 600/paid 600 -> merged leg becomes {passengers 1, base_fare 600, taxes_fees 30, bag_fees 70, seat_fees 40} => cost 740 instead of 600 (stale paid_on also kept). Also passengers is overwritten to 1. Fix: when the incoming leg came from a flat cost (_fare_of derived), REPLACE the leg (or zero taxes/bags/seats) instead of dict.update; consider adding amount_paid when it's a separate family-member ticket on the same direction.

minor.issue: apply_flight_rollups only runs segment sync when segments is truthy, so clearing all segments keeps legacy flight_number/depart_* fields and GET re-derives a segment ('out') from them — the deleted flight reappears. Clear legacy fields when segments is an explicit empty list (core/flights.py L90).
_existing() queries bookings by user_id only (not household ids), so a co-parent's existing flight card on the same trip is not matched for auto-merge (dup-check uses household ids — inconsistent).
Fare with all zeros (user clears airfare) is ignored by rollups so old cost/amount_paid persist.
Sent-keys use segment id; legacy cards ('out'/'ret') get new uuids after first edit/merge, so a check-in SMS already sent under checkin_out may be re-sent once under seg_<uuid>.

ui_bugs.issue: On web preview Alert.alert with buttons is a no-op, so the Promise never resolves and the Save button spins forever after dup-check (verified: GET dup-check fired, no confirm POST). Add Platform.OS==='web' fallback (window.confirm) for 'This trip already has a flight'.

Only flights[0] is offered; with several flight cards per trip (multiple family members) the user can't pick which card to fill, and when no card matches (match=false) 'Fill in existing' fills an arbitrary first card.

update/setLeg use the `segments`/`fare` props (stale closure) instead of functional updaters; in automation a fast fill of airline followed by flight # lost the airline (airline saved as null). Slow typing persisted fine. Use setState(prev => ...) via onSegments callback form.

issues: Floating star FAB overlaps right edge of 'Save changes' button (booking-save-btn)
Segment trash icon is 16px with hitSlop 10 (~36px) < 44px touch target

Filter stack (athlete, kind, competition, travel type, date range, team, category, status) fills the whole first viewport on 390x844 — no expense rows visible without scrolling; consider a collapsible filter panel
Athlete filter does not apply to travel rows, so 'Grand total' mixes athlete-filtered expenses with unfiltered travel

action_items: Fix merge_flight fare merge: replace (not dict.update) a leg when the import supplies a flat cost so stale taxes/bags/seats/passengers don't inflate cost (expected 600, got 740)
apply_flight_rollups: when segments == [] explicitly, null legacy flight fields so deleted flights don't reappear

inbox.tsx: add web fallback for the multi-button 'This trip already has a flight' Alert (currently hangs on web); let user choose which flight card when several exist, and don't default-merge into a non-matching card
FlightItineraryEditor: use functional state updates for segment/fare edits
confirm-all: use household ids when loading existing bookings
Move/offset FAB so it doesn't overlap the booking save button
